verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS code-review product publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public source repository or an open-source license for cubic. The published OpenAPI specs, llms.txt, CLI and MCP server are documentation and interfaces, not open source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
